description:
✨ 𝗧𝗜𝗧𝗟𝗘 𝗧𝗔𝗟𝗞 𝗘𝗣. 𝟬 ✨

Ever heard your Realtor say,
“Your property is 𝗶𝗻 𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘄”…

and thought,
“Wait… where exactly is escrow?” 🤔🏡

I sat down with 𝗔𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮 𝗦𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗼𝘀, owner of 𝗣𝗼𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝗧𝗶𝘁𝗹𝗲 in Harker Heights, TX, to answer some of the most common questions buyers, sellers, and investors ask during the closing process. 📑✨

In this first episode, we’re breaking down what it actually means when a home is “in escrow” — in simple, real-life terms. 🏠🔑

Whether you’re buying, selling, or investing in Central Texas, knowing what happens behind the scenes can make the process feel so much less intimidating. 🙌

🎥 𝗠𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗧𝗶𝘁𝗹𝗲 & 𝗘𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘄 𝟭𝟬𝟭 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗼𝗼𝗻!
